node.label: Popliteal synovial cyst
node.definition: A fluid-filled mass that is a distention of a preexisting bursa in the popliteal fossa, most commonly the gastrocnemio-semimembranosus bursa. This bursa is unique in that it communicates with the knee joint, unlike other periarticular bursae, via an opening in the joint capsule posterior to the medial femoral condyle.

evidence.snippet: Mucopolysaccharidosis type IX: Popliteal synovial cyst (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
